title: Billable package layout + pipe chart Videos/Reports/Images
description:
Build Billable Package always creates the job folder with Videos, Reports, and Images under the customer location you pick (for example AJJ/CALLAWAY…/Videos|Reports|Images), then copies your selected files into those folders.

The pipe chart View PDF / View Photos buttons now only look inside that job folder’s Videos, Reports, and Images folders (any capitalization). Manual folders with those names work the same way. DB3 linking is unchanged.

Who is affected: PipeShare users building customer packages and reviewing pipe charts on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Billable package always creates Videos, Reports, and Images under the job-named folder.
Pipe chart scans only Videos / Reports / Images under the open job folder (case-insensitive).
Those media folders hydrate automatically so PDF and photo buttons can appear.
DB3 binding on the package root and category folders is unchanged.
